capabilities: Capture webpages, tweets, and YouTube videos with timestamped transcripts via a companion Chrome extension
Generate AI read-worthiness verdicts and one-sentence answers to clickbait headlines
Highlight new insights versus concepts already present in existing knowledge trees
Extract insights and attach them hierarchically into topic knowledge trees
Save clean raw markdown copies of captures into a nutegg/_raw/ archive folder
extras: README explicitly lists limitations ('What You Should Not Expect': not for textbooks, courses, or entertainment) and says podcast and PDF support is in development; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A local sync server runs on port 27123.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture web content or triage it, so readers save material they never get to and waste time re-learning concepts they already know.

relations.evidence: Install the companion NutEgg from Chrome Web Store.
Choose your preferred provider (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.) and enter your API key.
relations.plugin: Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek

requires.name: AI provider API key (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)

summary: AI-assisted web capture system that analyzes webpages, tweets, and YouTube videos and organizes the insights into structured knowledge trees in the vault.
